findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler without implementing abstract methods
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` was changed to subclass `StatefulDetectorHandler` with only `pass` in its body, without implementing the abstract methods `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. Previously it implemented `evaluate` on `DetectorHandler` so it could be instantiated. Now, accessing `detector.detector_handler` for a detector with `type="metric_alert_fire"` will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...` at runtime.

findings.title: get_group_key_values return type annotation does not allow None group keys
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler.get_group_key_values` is annotated as returning `dict[str, int]`, whereas group keys throughout the module (including `evaluate`, `get_state_data`, `evaluate_group_key_value`, and the tests in `test_detector.py` line 148) can be `None` (i.e., `DetectorGroupKey`). The return type should be `dict[DetectorGroupKey, int]`.
